subject: Contract amendment request: EU data residency + APAC surge capacity during renewal
messages:
From: Eline Hansen <eline.hansen@greencare.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marc Dubois <marc.dubois@greencare.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract update: EU data residency & APAC surge for upcoming renewal

Hi Connor,

As we approach our July renewal, we need to scope two updates to the contract and the rollout plan:

1) EU primary residency: Greencare needs primary processing and persistent storage for EU traffic routed to an EU region (GDPR controls + local residency for patient data). We are not changing product calls, just where tokens, embeddings, and audit logs are stored.

2) APAC surge/pilot: We plan a Q4 pilot for an APAC on‑ramp (Singapore region) with burstable capacity for peak reporting windows — estimate 2–6x current peak for short windows. This will be a 6–12 month pilot tied to a commitment during the renewal period.

Key asks from our side: a short summary of the contract amendments (DPA + residency clause), a high‑level SOW for the APAC pilot (expected start: 2027‑10‑01), and an estimate of the incremental monthly cost for both EU residency and APAC burst. Our current contract ID is DEAL-4821 and the current term expires 2027‑07‑31.

Can you loop in legal/ops and send a draft amendment + SOW? We will need SOC2 evidence and an updated DPA for procurement.

Thanks,

Eline Hansen
Head of Cloud Ops, Greencare Health
eline.hansen@greencare.com
+47 22 33 44 55

Attachments: Greencare_Migration_Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet of privacy/compliance checklist)
From: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Eline Hansen <eline.hansen@greencare.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract update: EU data residency & APAC surge for upcoming renewal

Hi Eline — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. Copying Aditya (sales lead) and Vivek (solutions/infra) to align on pricing and residency constraints.

High level next steps from Redwood:
- Legal/Contracts: we'll prepare a short contract amendment that adds an EU residency clause + DPA updates. Expect a redline by 2027‑06‑03.
- SOW (APAC pilot): we will draft an SOW outlining the pilot scope (capacity, monitoring, rollback/failover runbook). Draft SOW link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bRedwood-SOW-Draft (editable).
- Capacity sizing: initial proposal below (open to your feedback):
  • EU primary pool: reserved capacity equivalent to 4 x A100 (predictable throughput for production), with autoscale headroom to 6 for short spikes
  • APAC pilot burst: base reserved of 2 x A100 with burst to 6 (burst windows controlled by RBAC & traffic routing policy)
- Security/compliance: we'll include SOC 2 Type II evidence and the DPA as part of the amendment package. KMS integration for customer keys can be added as an optional item in the SOW.
- Timeline ask: confirm whether you want the EU residency to be effective at renewal (2027‑08‑01) or staged (EU residency active 2027‑09‑01) — this affects migration windows and pricing.

Pricing: we'll produce a simple delta spreadsheet with incremental monthly cost and one‑time migration/validation fees by 2027‑06‑03.

Can you confirm the target effective date for EU residency and whether the APAC pilot should be billed as a separate 6‑month pilot commitment or rolled into the main 12‑month renewal? Once we have that we will finalize the redline and the SOW.

Best,

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Connor,

Thanks — procurement here. A few clarifying questions so we can route internally:
1) Price impact: please provide the incremental monthly cost and one‑time onboarding/migration fees in a single table (line items: EU residency storage delta, EU reserved compute, APAC reserved compute, APAC burst allowance, SOC2/DPA/legal review fees).
2) SLA & failover: we need clear wording on cross‑region failover behavior (RTO, RPO, known latencies for APAC failover to EU, and whether data is replicated synchronous vs asynchronous).
3) Evidence: provide SOC2 report, DPA, and a short runbook for the migration cutover and rollback.

We can fast‑track signing if pricing and the DPA look good; otherwise this will require additional approvals.

-Marc
Procurement, Greencare Health
procurement@greencare.com
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marc Dubois <marc.dubois@greencare.com>, Eline Hansen <eline.hansen@greencare.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract update: EU data residency & APAC surge for upcoming renewal

Marc / Eline — appreciate the clear checklist. Attached are the draft materials and a short summary below to aid procurement review.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_EU-APAC-draft.docx, Contract_Amendment_redline_v1.pdf, Greencare_Migration_Requirements.xlsx

Summary of proposed contract amendment (high level):
- Term: 12‑month renewal beginning 2027‑08‑01 (option to extend 12 months for APAC pilot).
- EU residency: Redwood will provision an EU primary region for Greencare traffic and persist tokens/embeddings/audit logs within EU geographic boundaries. DPA updated to reflect data controller/processor obligations and SCCs.
- APAC pilot: 6 month pilot starting 2027‑10‑01 with base reserved capacity of 2 units and burst allowance to 6 units. Burst charging model: metered per‑token during burst windows with agreed monthly cap.
- Failover & replication: cross‑region failover is asynchronous replication by default; RTO target 15 minutes for session reconnect and 1 hour for full KV cache warmup. Synchronous replication available as an add‑on (one‑time migration fee + 25% ongoing charge on storage/compute).

Pricing delta (illustrative, final spreadsheet attached):
- One‑time migration & validation fee: $45,000
- Incremental monthly (EU residency + reserved compute): $18,000 / month
- APAC pilot incremental: $6,500 / month (reserve) + metered burst with $5,000 monthly cap

Proposed timeline / milestones:
- 2027‑06‑03: Pricing & redline (we committed to this; redline sent)
- 2027‑06‑20: Procurement feedback / negotiate commercial terms
- 2027‑06‑25: Sign amendment (target) / DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/greencare/redwood/DEAL-4821
- 2027‑08‑01: EU residency goes live (if signed) — validation window + smoke tests (2 weeks)
- 2027‑10‑01: APAC pilot start (subject to separate SOW)

Next steps for us: please confirm whether procurement is comfortable with the migration fee and the RTO/RPO wording above. We can tighten SLA language in the redline if you want synchronous replication as the standard.

If procurement gives a green light we will move the amendment to DocuSign and schedule a technical runbook review call with Vivek and Eline next week.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this in June.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
